title: Luis Enrique trying to 'manage the noise' around superstar Doue
subtitle: Desire Doue has had a sensational start to the season, and Luis Enrique says the only difficult thing is managing the "noise" around him.
paragraphs: Luis Enrique claimed the only difficulty when it comes to managing Desire Doue is keeping a lid on the hype around the Paris Saint-Germain star.

Doue has made a sensational start to the season. He starred against Barcelona and Manchester City in the Champions League, and has contributed to eight goals in total (four goals, four assists) in all competitions.
With Ousmane Dembele and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia out injured, the onus is on Doue to keep performing for PSG, who top Ligue 1 ahead of facing Le Havre on Friday.
But when asked about managing such a talent, Luis Enrique said: "For a player of his technical ability and age, the most difficult thing is managing the noise around him.
"It's the most difficult for me because I know Desire Doue perfectly. He's a player with an incredible work ethic and a constant desire to help the team.
"When you substitute him, he's always smiling on the bench. He wants to help the team. He's an incredible player and a joy to watch for children, for anyone who loves football.
"I encourage him to continue doing things the same way; to be humble and ambitious, because it's important to be ambitious. I hope he continues doing what he's doing."
Luis Enrique has now won 126 matches in charge of PSG, equalling the club record set by Laurent Blanc.
"I'm old, well, old enough, to know what kind of noise and music you can hear around a club," Luis Enrique said when asked about potentially setting a new record at PSG.
"I know what I can hear. When things are complicated, and we've had some difficult times over the last three years.
"We are where we want to be. But this is just the beginning; we know it will be tough. [Friday's game] will be a difficult match to manage, but we have the experience of past years."
Le Havre - Ahmed Touba
Touba has made 17 interceptions in Ligue 1 this season, the most by any player.
With Le Havre sitting bottom of the table, if they are to get a result, their defensive work will be crucial, so centre-back Touba could be key.
While there is pressure on Doue to fill in for PSG's absent stars, Luis Enrique still has plenty of quality to call on in attack.
One of those players is Ferran Torres, who is PSG's leading scorer in Ligue 1 this term, with four goals.
MATCH PREDICTION: PSG WIN
PSG have lost just 12% of their Ligue 1 matches against Le Havre (4/34), only recording a better ratio against Brest (8%) among teams they have faced as many times.
Le Havre have lost each of their last five home Ligue 1 matches against PSG, but have never suffered six consecutive defeats against the same opponent on home soil in the top tier.
In fact, Le Havre have lost their last four Ligue 1 matches, the longest current run in the division alongside Strasbourg, conceding 11 goals in that period, an average of 2.8 per game.
PSG, on the other hand, have won their last eight matches in all competitions, their best run since between January and March 2025 (10).
And Le Havre are winless in their last nine home Ligue 1 matches (D4 L5), the second-longest current run behind Troyes (21) and their longest ever in the competition.
Le Havre – 11.5%
